Section 4.0 — HSE Checklist
Health, Safety & Environmental
Check all items observed and compliant during the inspection visit
HSE Observations Checklist
# Item Yes No
1 Have you received a safety induction (and/or toolbox health and safety talk for visit), detailing the risks & rules relevant to your visit?
2 Are all persons in view correctly wearing suitable and sufficient personal protective equipment that is appropriate for the risks?
3 Is the site clean and well organised with good housekeeping and waste disposal arrangements?
4 Are all personnel seen to be working in a safe manner during your visit?
5 Is the machinery and equipment seen to be well maintained and operated in a safe manner?
6 Has your visit been free from any incidents, accidents or dangerous occurrences (Slips, Trips, Dropped Equipment, CoSHH)?
7 Do the Management of the premises visited convey a positive Health and Safety Culture?
